title: Khrushchev and the U-2 wreckage (Francis Gary Powers shootdown, May 1960)
description: Black-and-white photograph of Soviet Premier Khrushchev and other men in overcoats viewing the displayed wreckage of the downed U-2, with Khrushchev pointing at the debris with a stick and a uniformed officer nearby. Captioned "Khrushchev and the U-2 wreckage." Chapter 4 text (page 180) below describes the collapse of the US cover story, Eisenhower's 11 May statement and the failed Paris summit.
